inference_scope: conditional on frozen fitted assets and training data; across-fit and training-procedure variability unidentifiable

amendment.input_reuse_basis: Unopened first24 protected inputs retain all content/identity/seed lineage via stable append.36 new originals added; separate registry snapshot preserves earlier freezes.
amendment.reason: Prospective N24 to N60 sample and capacity decision before any protected outcome; preserve both older freezes.

bootstrap.algorithm: stratified original-template bootstrap, all paired methods/budgets/repeats kept together; complete fit runs independently crossed
bootstrap.few_fit: one genuine fit; across-fit interval unavailable, no seed-alias resampling
bootstrap.ordinary: two-sided percentile .025/.975 conditional on frozen fit
bootstrap.simultaneous: two-sided Bonferroni alpha/(2B), B=6 unique contrasts; B3/B4 same outcome/contrast

exclusions.censoring: cost lower bounds and unknown tails retained, no deletion
exclusions.deadline: available utility retained; overshoot fully costed
exclusions.external_interrupt: only same immutable request retry allowed; preserve all prior attempts and costs
exclusions.method_fault: retained zero utility, halt and diagnose; any scientific fix requires numbered amendment and fresh untouched confirmation where needed
exclusions.missing: no complete primary analysis until every queue key has one authoritative effective outcome
exclusions.numerical_alarm: quarantine configuration; no superiority claim; halt
exclusions.stopping: one fixed queue, no significance stopping, no protected tuning

guardrails.budgets: primal-only, dual-only, absolute objectives, raw gap, solved fraction, first verified improvement/optimality, gap-time area
guardrails.interpretation: tight negative, tight-null, wide inconclusive reported distinctly; no fixed-control result rebranded adaptive
guardrails.primal_regression: frontier win with primal regression is a tradeoff; never unqualified improvement
guardrails.resources: failures, overshoot/release/publication, wall/CPU/RSS/storage, native work/admin fraction and supported action calibration
guardrails.status: secondary exploratory; no simultaneous secondary improvement claim
guardrails.training: separate sunk training/tuning/failure costs; no wall-time subtraction or invented amortization

telemetry.scope: common learned trace bound, charged in every applicable method

watchdog.policy: cooperative absolute deadline; parent grace then termination; only independently validated parent receipts by deadline score
